scientific_integrity: General finite-parameter theorem proved by uniform injection completion and rising-factorial identities; finite exact enumeration supplements rather than replaces proof.
scientific_limitations: The polynomial marks the total original-permutation cycle count and one specified one-line upper-record indicator; it does not assert a multivariate full-record-vector law or stochastic association. Independent historical-priority validation has not been completed.
title: A joint cycle–record polynomial for uniform permutations
